messages.text: Research terrain and structure generation and multi-genre multi-biome generation and furnishing for the rust voxel infinite labyrinth project NOT maw of the ouro or the C# IL. This generation and procedural building engine will be based on a 5cm voxel resolution and must rival the complexity of Minecraft and Barony and Shadows of Doubt.

This is a rich, well-scoped research task. Launching a deep dive now.

Your procedural generation architecture report for a 5cm voxel engine in Rust is ready. It covers terrain generation with noise layering and hybrid density fields, palette-compressed chunk storage with binary greedy meshing, multi-biome blending via 6D parameter spaces, structure generation combining graph grammars and jigsaw assembly, anchor-based room furnishing with constraint scoring, and a 7-pass generation pipeline modeled on Veloren's two-tier architecture. The report includes implementation-ready data structures, recommended Rust crates, and distilled patterns from Minecraft, Shadows of Doubt, Dwarf Fortress, Caves of Qud, and other reference games.
